description: Automatic game image mounter - Mount .ffpkg, .exfat, and .ffpfs images automatically without manual intervention

changelog: ⚠ This is a pre-release version. Use with caution.
Introduced configuration format v2, with separate config.ini and profiles.ini, automatic migration, and runtime reloads.
Improved mount and launch recovery, including safer cleanup of sandbox layers and handling for M.2 storage.
Made library scans more resilient to inaccessible folders and source changes.
Improved metadata and filename handling for PS4 trophies, sce_sys files, and dynamic libraries.
Added browser back navigation, an option to disable startup library notifications, and better support for long image mount paths.
Unified PKG installation queue with cover cards for PC, local storage and SMB.
Select up to 32 PC files; additional selections append without duplicates.
Automatic game → update → DLC ordering for PC batches.
Failed or cancelled queues retain unfinished packages.
Improved PS4 DLC and PS5 media PKG detection.
Fixed premature DLC installation failures (0x80E90004).
Fixed json-c memory leaks during repeated scans.
Added estimated remaining installation time.
Improved read-only destination handling.
Added safe USB drive ejection from the web interface.
Enabled library scans and operations on other games during gameplay while protecting the active game.
Fixed SMB guest connections and added a guest/authenticated access switch.
Added a read-only mode for SMB connections.
Removed forced closure of FPKG games when entering Rest Mode.
Added SMB2/SMB3 support for network file transfers and installation.
Big thanks to @owendswang and @john-tornblom for the libraries.
Added installation of game folders and images into a selected local directory.
Improved PKG upload speed, SMB transfers and installation reliability.
Fixed intermittent Input/output error failures during installation.
Added file deletion and folder creation in the installation browser.
Added free-space information for local drives and SMB shares.
Improved mobile and gamepad navigation,
